about_the_game:
Experience the high-speed core of Void Wave Drift in this action-packed playable demo.

Void Wave Drift is a futuristic combat racing game where you pilot Ionblades—sleek anti-gravity ships built for speed, strategy, and destruction. Compete in high-stakes races across alien worlds, orbital cities, and unstable rift zones as you chase glory in a galaxy torn by chaos.

What's Included in the Demo

This free demo offers a focused slice of the full experience:

  • 1 Track set on the alien planet Orryx, featuring gravity-defying segments, destructible paths, and environmental hazards.

  • 3 Game Modes available on this track:

    • Classic Circuit

    • Elimination Sprint

    • Time Trial

  • 3 Playable Ionblades:

    • Scorch Runner – A high-acceleration brawler built for aggressive racing.

    • Interceptor – Balanced and responsive, ideal for precision control.

    • Echo Arc – Lightweight, drift-focused, and built for high-speed cornering.

  • Full access to combat mechanics, tactical powerups, and destructible track shortcuts.

Core Gameplay Features

Drift the Void
Race on gravity-defying tracks filled with loops, jumps, vertical drops, and hazardous turns. Master aerial control, boost management, and momentum-based cornering across a variety of futuristic environments.

Powerups
Equip a selection of offensive and defensive tools mid-race. Use EMPs to disable opponents, activate shields to survive incoming attacks, or clear a path with high-powered rift charges.

Destructible Shortcuts
Strategically destroy track segments to reveal hidden shortcuts. Blasting your way through can shave precious seconds—but mistimed shots may cost you the lead.

Multiple Game Modes
Take on various challenges, including:

  • Classic Circuit Races – Focus on raw speed and precise execution.

  • Elimination Sprints – The slowest racer is removed at regular intervals—stay fast or be cut.

  • Time Trials and Speed Challenges – Race the clock to set your best times.

Sleek and Stylish Presentation
Void Wave Drift blends sharp sci-fi visuals with a synth-fueled soundtrack. Inspired by neon-drenched classics and modern racing titans, the game delivers a bold aesthetic and pulse-pounding audio to match its high-speed action.

Precision. Destruction. Speed.
Void Wave Drift is more than a race. Are you fast enough to survive the void?

short_description: Customize your Ionblade and race through gravity-defying tracks in Void Wave Drift, a sleek anti-gravity combat racer. Use powerups, destroy the track to forge shortcuts, and master the Drift in a high-speed fight for glory across the galaxy.
